probeSources.desktopRoundtrip: async(page)=>{const waited=page.waitForResponse(r=>{if(!r.url().endsWith('/graphql'))return false;try{const q=r.request().postDataJSON();return(Array.isArray(q)?q:[q]).some(x=>x.operationName==='BlueprintPreview'&&x.variables.repo==='https://github.com/bex-co/bex'&&x.variables.path==='examples/hello-go/render.yaml');}catch{return false;}},{timeout:45000});await page.getByRole('option',{name:'main',exact:true}).click();const pending={at:new Date().toISOString(),deployDisabled:await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Deploy Blueprint',exact:true}).isDisabled(),ui:await page.locator('main').ariaSnapshot()};const response=await waited;const raw=response.request().postDataJSON(),qs=Array.isArray(raw)?raw:[raw],rb=await response.json(),bs=Array.isArray(rb)?rb:[rb];const i=qs.findIndex(x=>x.operationName==='BlueprintPreview');await page.getByText('Blueprint file parsed successfully — 1 resource will change.',{exact:true}).waitFor();const capture=async()=>({repo:await page.getByRole('textbox',{name:'Repository URL',exact:true}).inputValue(),branch:await page.getByRole('combobox',{name:'Branch',exact:true}).inputValue(),name:await page.getByRole('textbox',{name:'Blueprint Name',exact:true}).inputValue(),path:await page.getByRole('textbox',{name:'Blueprint path',exact:true}).inputValue(),deployEnabled:await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Deploy Blueprint',exact:true}).isEnabled(),ui:await page.locator('main').ariaSnapshot()});const before=await capture();await page.getByRole('tab',{name:'GitHub',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('tab',{name:'Public Git URL',exact:true}).click();const after=await capture();return{at:new Date().toISOString(),viewport:page.viewportSize(),pending,request:qs[i],status:response.status(),body:bs[i],before,after}}

sourceExcerpts.text:
<ServiceSourcePicker
                  titleKey="blueprints.createSourceTitle"
                  idPrefix="bp"
                  tab={tab}
                  onTabChange={(next) => {
                    const draft =
                      tab === "git" ? { gitUrl, branch } : gitBranchDraft;
                    setGitBranchDraft(draft);
                    setTab(next);
                    setSelectedRepo(null);
                    setBranch(
                      next === "git" && draft?.gitUrl === gitUrl
                        ? draft.branch
                        : "",
                    );
                  }}
                  selectedRepo={selectedRepo}
                  onSelectRepo={setSelectedRepo}
                  gitUrl={gitUrl}
                  onGitUrlChange={setGitUrl}
                />

                {/* Settings */}
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label htmlFor="bp-name">
                      {t("blueprints.createNameLabel")}

Independent service-create branch retention and Cancel
